title: Two Sum
difficulty: Easy
position: 2
=== statement
Given an array of `n` integers and a number `target`, find the two different positions whose values add up to `target`. Exactly one such pair exists.
=== input
The first line has `n` and `target`. The second line has the `n` integers.
=== output
Print the two positions `i j` (0-based, with `i < j`).
=== constraints
2 <= n <= 20000
-10^9 <= values <= 10^9
Exactly one pair adds up to target.
=== sample
4 9
2 7 11 15
--- expected
0 1
=== sample
3 6
3 2 4
--- expected
1 2
=== test
2 0
-5 5
--- expected
0 1
=== test
3 10
10 0 7
--- expected
0 1
=== test
5 -3
19 33 -10 5 -36
--- expected
1 4
=== test
8 -22
-40 -7 -15 26 23 40 33 7
--- expected
1 2
=== test
12 39
39 43 -38 -39 0 8 20 -7 -41 -13 28 -46
--- expected
0 4
=== test
